name: Alice
source:
What really are dreams?

Nik, the protagonist has always been a lucid dreamer.
However since he was young, Alice would always show up in his dreams.
She seems to be in full control of his dreams, and knows exactly when he's about to wake up.
Until one day, He wakes up only to find himself crying...
"Am i... crying?
Her name...
What was it?"

Who really is Alice? Why is she always showing up in his dreams?

[From [url=https://nikvn.itch.io/alice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梦究竟是什么？

主角Nik一直是个清醒梦者。
然而从他年幼时起，Alice便总会出现在他的梦里。她似乎完全掌控着他的梦，也确切知道他何时即将醒来。
直到有一天，他醒来时发现自己在哭……
“我……在哭吗？
她的名字……
是什么来着？”

Alice究竟是谁？她为何总是出现在他的梦中？

[摘自[url=https://nikvn.itch.io/alice]Itch.io[/url]]
